    Weights of pretorsion theories in cutoff coordinates #

    The weight x^{ρ_n(T)} q^{|ind(T ∩ F)|} of a pretorsion theory (T_β, F_α) of mod Λ_n (Definition 7.1) in terms of the cutoffs: ρ_n(T_β) is the number of rows a with β a = n, and |ind(T_β ∩ F_α)| is the number of pairs a ≤ d with d < β a and α d ≤ a, counted column by column.
